outcome: Use of intrapartum interventions (amniotomy, epidural anesthesia, oxytocin augmentation)
cohort: 21,858 nulliparous women with singleton, term vertex births
finding: Women admitted in early labor (0-3 cm and 4-5 cm cervical dilation) were more likely to receive the combination of amniotomy, epidural anesthesia, and oxytocin augmentation and had a higher likelihood of cesarean birth compared to women admitted at 6-10 cm dilation.
mod_finding: Women admitted in early labor (0-3 cm and 4-5 cm cervical dilation) had a higher likelihood of cesarean birth compared to women admitted at 6-10 cm dilation.
